ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sigmazam uses the microphone so you can send voice messages and talk on voice calls with your friends.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sigmazam uses the camera so you can take a photo together with your friends in the Photo Booth.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sigmazam opens your photos so you can send one in a chat or choose a picture for a character.
